text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild neutropenia and lymphopenia, with monocytosis and basophilia. There is also mild hypoglycemia and elevated creatinine, suggesting possible renal impairment. The findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or infiltration, and/or a systemic process such as infection, inflammation, or hypoxic injury. Immediate clinical correlation and further diagnostic workup are recommended.
